snippet.title: In Hope Voiden Trailer - Deutsche Indie Showcase / Summer Game Fest
snippet.description:
12 lives.

12 characters.

No second chances.

Our newest trailer for In Hope Voiden is here, featuring never-before-seen locations, new gameplay, and a deeper look into the forgotten battlefield consumed by fanaticism and entropy.

When one character dies, their story ends.
Another takes their place.
Until no one remains.
